dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing of the body mass from the maximum width of the mid-body toward the visible posterior section.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations; consistent convex curvature through the mid-section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to pale blue-grey median intensity; characteristic of a sub-adult or transitional color phase rather than mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches observed primarily along the left lateral-dorsal flank (image perspective).
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter primary canvas and the localized darker grey clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-frequency, small-scale white punctate marks across the dorsal surface, likely associated with surface water droplets or air bubbles; faint linear striae on the lower right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle, multi-directional linear scratches or shallow marks visible on the right posterior-lateral skin surface.
